direction_statistic.definition: same-index common-finite matched rank minus shuffled rank; pair median; equal-weight median across the frozen eight-pair roster
direction_statistic.comparability_note: Values are directly comparable as frozen public directional statistics, while each confirmation stage uses its own independent references and attacks.

pair_direction_median.definition: pair median over positions where matched and shuffled ranks are both finite at the same list index

transform_direction_statistic.definition: equal-weight median of the two public reference medians for a transform

d01_missingness.definition: public finite/null rank counts and retained record counts; not a direction statistic

unavailable_or_not_directly_comparable.D0: The public D0 receipt exposes unit, shard, topology, status, and identity aggregates but not layer comparison metrics.
unavailable_or_not_directly_comparable.D01_selection_sort_tuple: The public receipt exposes a five-component tuple without component labels; it is retained as an opaque tuple and is not relabeled.
unavailable_or_not_directly_comparable.selection_vs_confirmation: D0.1 and D0.2 are selection observations; D1 and D2 are independent confirmation observations.
